videos.caption: ✨ 6 Skincare Ingredients That Actually Work Skin concerns can feel confusing, but choosing the right ingredient makes it much easier 👀 Blackheads → BHA Oily skin → Niacinamide Dry skin → Ceramide Closed comedones → Adapalene Wrinkles → Retinal Acne → Azelaic acid BHA can help with blackheads and clogged pores, niacinamide is often used for oily skin support, ceramides help support dry skin and the skin barrier, adapalene is commonly used for closed comedones, retinal can help with smoother-looking fine lines, and azelaic acid is often used for acne-prone skin. Some ingredients, like adapalene or retinal, may not be suitable for everyone, so use them carefully and ask a pharmacist or dermatologist if you’re unsure.
